name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist
steps: Sit with your knees bent and heels on the floor, holding a medicine ball against your chest.
Lean back from your hips and brace your abdomen to hold that trunk angle.
Rotate your torso and shoulders smoothly to one side to bring the medicine ball toward the floor beside your hip.
Twist back through center toward the opposite hip, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Turn your chest and shoulders with the ball rather than simply moving your arms side to side.
Keep your heels grounded if lifting your feet causes your lower back to round.
